issues.description: The problem statement and the template expect Course.getAverageRating() to return a Double (and even hint to compute Double(sumOfStars) / Double(totalRatings)), but the solution implements getAverageRating() with return type Int and uses integer division. This contradicts the specification and template signature. It can confuse students (and tests) about the expected return type and the correct averaging behavior (including non-integer averages and dividing by zero handling).
issues.suggested_fix: Align the solution with the problem/template by changing Course.getAverageRating() in the solution to return Double and compute the average using floating-point arithmetic (e.g. return Double(sumOfStars) / Double(totalRatings)), and return a reasonable Double value (e.g. 0.0) when there are no ratings. Ensure the method signature is func getAverageRating() -> Double to match the specification.
